@graph.name: Rebel Red's Gyros — Gyroplane Flight Training
@graph.description: FAA-approved gyroplane flight training in Lamesa, Texas. Earn your Sport Pilot or Private Pilot gyroplane certificate with CFI Matt Snell. Transition training also available for licensed pilots.

hasCourse.name: Sport Pilot Gyroplane Certificate
hasCourse.description: Complete FAA Sport Pilot certificate training in a gyroplane with CFI Matt Snell in Lamesa, TX. Covers preflight, ground operations, basic maneuvers, cross-country flight, and emergency procedures. Minimum 20 flight hours required by FAA.

hasCourse.name: Private Pilot Gyroplane Certificate
hasCourse.description: Full FAA Private Pilot certificate training in a gyroplane. Includes instrument fundamentals, cross-country navigation, night operations, and all FAA required maneuvers. Taught by CFI/CFII Matt Snell in Lamesa, TX.

hasCourse.name: Gyroplane Transition Training
hasCourse.description: Already a licensed fixed-wing or helicopter pilot? Transition training with CFI Matt Snell at Rebel Red's Gyros gives licensed pilots the skills and endorsement needed to safely fly gyroplanes. Customized to your existing experience.
